body:
Revert "perf(linear): try two-CTA bound on Muse R48 sm86"

This reverts commit 09bbbf01d0a70ca1effff9cded91e1284b4734ef.
patch:
diff --git a/src/ops/linear/q4/q4_rowsplit_gemm_mma_sm89.cu b/src/ops/linear/q4/q4_rowsplit_gemm_mma_sm89.cu
index 77fd239e..fb7c8962 100644
--- a/src/ops/linear/q4/q4_rowsplit_gemm_mma_sm89.cu
+++ b/src/ops/linear/q4/q4_rowsplit_gemm_mma_sm89.cu
@@ -27,7 +27,7 @@ using Q4MmaR64C40K128Schedule =
 
 #if GINFER_COMPILED_CC == 86
 using Q4MmaR48C40K128Schedule =
-    Q4RowSplitMmaGemmSchedule<48, 40, 128, 16, 8, 2, 2, Q4FragmentPipeline::Serial, Cache::cg,
+    Q4RowSplitMmaGemmSchedule<48, 40, 128, 16, 8, 2, 1, Q4FragmentPipeline::Serial, Cache::cg,
                               Cache::cg, Q4ScaleLoad::Pair32>;
 #endif
subject: Revert "perf(linear): try two-CTA bound on Muse R48 sm86"

patch:
diff --git a/docs/results/2026-08-21-sm86-agentic-kernel-campaign.md b/docs/results/2026-08-21-sm86-agentic-kernel-campaign.md
index a40e456e..89bed18c 100644
--- a/docs/results/2026-08-21-sm86-agentic-kernel-campaign.md
+++ b/docs/results/2026-08-21-sm86-agentic-kernel-campaign.md
@@ -364,13 +364,25 @@ Raw Server 2 evidence remains ignored under:
 - `profiles/sm86/rtx3090/muse-glimmer-cycle9/baseline-a9dfd22e/`;
 - `profiles/sm86/rtx3090/muse-glimmer-cycle9/candidate4-d48292fa/`;
 - `profiles/sm86/rtx3090/muse-glimmer-cycle10/baseline-e20d1418/`;
-- `profiles/sm86/rtx3090/muse-glimmer-cycle10/candidate13-5b23d128/`.
+- `profiles/sm86/rtx3090/muse-glimmer-cycle10/candidate13-5b23d128/`;
+- `profiles/sm86/rtx3090/muse-glimmer-cycle11/`.
 
 Continuous telemetry records timestamp, temperature, GPU utilization, SM and memory
 clocks, power, and resident memory. Public Linear CSV files retain the semantic one-read
 effective-GB/s model and the RTX 3090 DRAM-reference percentages. Nsight reports remain
 diagnostic evidence and are not committed.
 
-Muse optimization is still active. Cycle 11 starts from the accepted cycle-10 source and a
-fresh profile before its first candidate. No SM89 or SM120a runtime claim is made by these
-SM86 results.
+Cycle 11 is preserved after five rejected candidates at restored source commit
+`8e0f1ab13ad49df9d1c52ba5207518c51c60181f`. Its fresh C1/C8 Nsight Systems profile and
+compact Nsight Compute packet identified the retained R48 route as the largest remaining
+single Q4 schedule. Candidates 1-4 tested fragment pipelining, activation caching, Q4-code
+caching, and scalar scale staging; none cleared public screening. Candidate 5 passed the
+independent Linear oracle, but the symmetric four-point screen was bit-identical at
+`K=4096`, `K=19968`, and `K=33280`; at `K=6656` it measured 158.592/158.624 us against
+158.720/158.720 us baseline, at most 0.08%. No Cycle 11 candidate reached the Program,
+Engine, or registered-real-test gates.
+
+Muse optimization remains active: this preservation checkpoint is not a completed no-win
+cycle and does not satisfy the terminal condition. Resume Cycle 11 at candidate 6 from the
+restored source and durable ledger. No SM89 or SM120a runtime claim is made by these SM86
+results.
diff --git a/docs/results/2026-08-21-sm86-muse-cycle11-ledger.csv b/docs/results/2026-08-21-sm86-muse-cycle11-ledger.csv
index fa8c33d9..fe82affe 100644
--- a/docs/results/2026-08-21-sm86-muse-cycle11-ledger.csv
+++ b/docs/results/2026-08-21-sm86-muse-cycle11-ledger.csv
@@ -3,3 +3,4 @@ cycle_candidate,commit,changed_mechanism,predicted_effect,oracle_result,public_o
 11.2,e9f28dea46b94c0b998255861586e7e7439e0dfa,"cache activation staging in L1 only for the exact CC86 Muse R48C40/BK128 Q4 schedule","exploit cross-CTA reuse across the 139-block grid without caching streaming weights","pass: independent FP64 Q4 Linear oracle","reject: all four affected T40 points regress 0.51-1.56% in symmetric paired measurements","not run: public screening disproved the cache policy","reject","608c38b8af6ab1af836d994806b4235dcc53d61d"
 11.3,e3c8083a0dae13941ce4a4ac4efc587bc0b77811,"cache Q4 code staging in L1 only for the exact CC86 Muse R48C40/BK128 schedule","test weight-side scoreboard reuse without changing activation caching or geometry","pass: independent FP64 Q4 Linear oracle","reject: two affected T40 points tie while the deep-K points regress 0.22-0.40% in symmetric paired measurements","not run: public screening disproved the cache policy","reject","07e401dee34d9f5f71775810c36eeba42265a3bf"
 11.4,acf7d0d8ca136d02460e8953983769f7e9e52239,"use scalar 16-bit scale staging only for the exact CC86 Muse R48C40/BK128 schedule","remove paired-scale bytes while preserving geometry and cache policies","pass: independent FP64 Q4 Linear oracle","reject: all four affected T40 points regress 1.00-2.68% in symmetric paired measurements","not run: public screening disproved the scale mode","reject","d822a11d39d6f2056dd27b7ddb068499cf91ad7f"
+11.5,09bbbf01d0a70ca1effff9cded91e1284b4734ef,"raise the compiler launch bound from one to two CTAs only for the exact CC86 Muse R48C40/BK128 schedule","make compiler residency explicit at the measured two-block shared-memory limit","pass: independent FP64 Q4 Linear oracle","below threshold: three affected T40 points are bit-identical and K6656 improves at most 0.08% in symmetric paired measurements","not run: public screening cannot produce either Program gate arm","reject","8e0f1ab13ad49df9d1c52ba5207518c51c60181f"
subject: docs(perf): checkpoint sm86 Muse cycle 11
